// AddOptions
interface AddOptions<P = unknown> {
    owner?: string;
    key?: string;
    writtenAt?: number;
    askAfterMs?: number;
    decide?: (queued: readonly OutboxItem<P>[]) => OutboxItem<P> | "hold" | undefined;
}

// AttemptOutcome
type AttemptOutcome = {
    type: "sent";
} | {
    type: "retry";
    error?: ItemError;
    noAnswer?: boolean;
    timedOut?: boolean;
} | {
    type: "busy";
    error?: ItemError;
} | {
    type: "conflict";
    error?: ItemError;
} | {
    type: "refused";
    error?: ItemError;
};

// CancelResult
type CancelResult = "cancelled" | "in_flight" | "not_found";

DEFAULT_POLICY: Readonly<Policy>

// DEFAULT_WRITTEN_AT_BOUNDS

// ERROR_IN_PROGRESS

// Outbox
class Outbox<P = unknown> {
    readonly policy: Readonly<Policy>;
    constructor(options: OutboxOptions<P>);
    add(kind: string, payload: P, options?: AddOptions<P>): Promise<OutboxItem<P>>;
    list(): Promise<OutboxEntry<P>[]>;
    cancel(key: string): Promise<CancelResult>;
    approve(key: string): Promise<RetryResult>;
    retry(key: string): Promise<RetryResult>;
    discard(key: string): Promise<DiscardResult>;
    isDurable(): Promise<boolean>;
    subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
    flush(owner?: string): Promise<FlushReport>;
}

// OutboxEntry
interface OutboxEntry<P> {
    item: OutboxItem<P>;
    status: ItemStatus;
}

// OutboxItem
interface OutboxItem<P = unknown> {
    key: string;
    kind: string;
    payload: P;
    owner?: string;
    writtenAt: number;
    state: ItemState;
    attempts: number;
    touched: boolean;
    claimedAt?: number;
    claimToken?: string;
    approvedAt?: number;
    held?: true;
    askBy?: number;
    stuckReason?: StuckReason;
    lastError?: ItemError;
    sentAt?: number;
    retryAt?: number;
    failures?: number;
    noAnswerSince?: number;
    timeouts?: number;
}

// OutboxOptions
interface OutboxOptions<P> {
    store: Store<P>;

    policy?: PolicyOptions;
    now?: () => number;

}

// Policy
interface Policy {
    maxAttempts: number;
    staleClaimMs: number;
    claimRenewMs: number;
    confirmAfterMs: number;
    attemptTimeoutMs: number;
    retryDelaysMs: readonly number[];

}

// PolicyOptions
type PolicyOptions = {
    [K in keyof Policy]?: Policy[K] | undefined;
};

// REPLAYED_HEADER

interface RequestHeaderOptions {
    omitWrittenAt?: boolean;

// RetryResult
type RetryResult = RetryStarted | {
    ok: false;
    reason: "not_found" | "not_stuck" | "not_waiting_for_approval";
};

// RetryStarted
interface RetryStarted {
    ok: true;

}

// SchedulerOptions

    isOnline?: () => boolean;

    onError?: (err: unknown) => void;
}
